test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + Z means 'A is the mother of Z',

A - Z means 'A is the brother of Z',

A × Z means 'A is the sister of Z',

A ÷ Z means 'A is the daughter of Z'.

Based on the above, how is J related to L, if ‘J + K ÷ L - T × R'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Sister
 Daughter
 
 

 

Given: J + K ÷ L - T × R

It means: J is the Mother of K, K is the Daughter of L, L is the Brother of T, T is the Sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1abd557f05042af4eb8d6705778a1e8b5e4b42f090d163d340ee94d42eb9f59a.png] 

So, J is the 'Wife' of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
